free_tier.stated: No published per-account total; 480 MB per file, lossless only (WAV/FLAC/AIFF, 16 or 24-bit, 44.1 or 48 kHz, 1-2 channels).

egress.terms: Free streaming and free download for listeners; Jamendo monetises through licensing, not storage fees.

tooling: Jamendo Artist web dashboard; licensing API exists for consumers of the catalogue, not for uploads.
chaining: Unlimited tracks per artist account x 480 MB. Same shape as Bandcamp but with a larger per-file cap and no sales gate.

limits.value: review step means an upload can be refused

limits_note: 480 MB per file; strict format spec (bit depth, sample rate, channel count all constrained); a track must be submitted to a Jamendo programme, so there is a review step.
reliability_note: Lossless in, transcoded for streaming; Jamendo's model is sync licensing so the catalogue is public. No retention risk stated, but the review step means an upload can be refused.

evidence.proved: 'WAV, FLAC, or AIFF'; 'Bit depth: 16 or 24'; 'The maximum size of a single file is 480 MB'

notes: No published per-account total; 480 MB per file, lossless only (WAV/FLAC/AIFF, 16 or 24-bit, 44.1 or 48 kHz, 1-2 channels).
